CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE
  AGENDA
  September 10, 2020
  MISSION STATEMENT
  The City of Alhambra is dedicated to responsive, creative leadership and
  quality services, ensuring desirable neighborhoods and a supportive
  business environment, while being sensitive to the diversity of our
  community.

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer At Home Order,
the Alhambra Environmental Committee meeting will not be physically open to the public and
all Environmental Committee Members will be participating through videoconference or
teleconference. Additionally, the public may also participate by video conference or
teleconference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Webinar as follows:
Zoom Webinar direct link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82035424339?pwd=VzVXMTBPaVdGV2RMdUxad0F2VVRxZz09
Passcode: 069187
Or by telephone by dialing 833 548 0282 (Toll Free) or 877 853 5257 (Toll Free) or 888 475 4499
(Toll Free) or 833 548 0276 (Toll Free) and entering Webinar ID: 820 3542 4339. Please Note: All
members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will be muted so that the meeting can
proceed.
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please email Deputy Director David Dolphin at
ddolphin@cityofalhambra.org 5:00 p.m. prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak
on and the phone number you will use when calling or the name you will use when logging into
the meeting. You should then call or log into the meeting at least 10 minutes prior to its start
time. Staff will unmute you and announce you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes
to speak, unless that time is adjusted. If you do not have access to a computer please call 626-300-
1571 to request public comment.
As an alternative to speaking during the meeting, you can email your comments to the David
Dolphin ddolphin@cityofalhambra.org by no later than 5:00 p.m. on September 10, 2020 to ensure
that the City has time to print the emails prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be
read into the record by the City Clerk, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment,
subject to the Mayor’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 p.m. but before the conclusion
of the meeting based upon its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a part of the record of
the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated
should email or call the Public Works Department at ddolphin@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 300-1571
who will use their best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility
as possible while also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of teleconference and video
conference meetings, all participants are encouraged to email their comments prior to the

  CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE
  AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
  Thursday, September 10, 2020
  7:00 p.m.

I.  Roll Call
  John Vuong
  Kim Luu
  Michael Daninger
  Esmerda Ruiz

II.  Flag Salute.

III.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS
  Each year the committee is appointed by the City Council. At this time it is appropriate to conduct
  an election to determine which members will chair the meeting as president and in the event the
  chair cannot attend the meeting, determine which member will step in as Vice President to conduct
  the meeting.
  Recommended Action: That the Committee elect a new president and vice president to chair the
  meeting.

IV.  MEASURE W OVERVIEW
  Deputy Director David Dolphin will give an update on Measure W, the Safe Clean Water Program
  and discuss the City’s proposal for a Green Street Demonstration Project on Main St at Fremont
  Ave.
  Recommended Action: Information only. No action required.

V.  PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments are welcome, but
  must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Committee. Please limit all oral
  communication to five (5) minutes. Speakers must fill out a blue speaker’s card, prior to the
  meeting and submit it to the Committee Secretary. Comments must pertain to the business of the
  Environmental Committee. Please limit all oral communications to five (5) minutes.

VI.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee members of any item not specified on the agenda. Items must
  pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Committee.

VII.  ADJOURNMENT
  2

 If you wish to address the Committee on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will be
heard during the Committee’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Committee on a subject
which does not appear on the agenda, but is of an environmental concern, your comments will be heard
under Public Comments. Please be advised that under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, the
committee cannot take action on any item which does not appear on the agenda.

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described above
are on file in the Utilities Department office and are available for public inspection upon request during
regular office hours, Monday through Thursday, 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Any question concerning agenda
items should be directed to Martin Ray, Director of Public Works & Utilities at (626) 570-3278.
